title: Odysseus mods index
description: A curated list of Odysseus mods. Odysseus marks every entry with verified true as Verified in Settings > Mods > Browse. Format: docs/mods.md, Running an index.

name.description: Shown as where a Verified badge comes from.

repo.description: The mod's GitHub repository, like https://github.com/owner/repo (no .git, no trailing slash).

id.description: The mod's id, as in its odysseus-mod.json.

verified.description: Reviewed: shown as Verified (only when the mod's manifest has a tutorial). false lists it as Community.

notes.description: Shown on the mod's details: what was reviewed, caveats.

blocked_versions.description: Exact versions (with or without a leading v) that must not be installed without an explicit override.

min_core.description: Raises the mod's min_core: Odysseus cores with an older mod API show it as not compatible.

subdir.description: The folder inside the repository the mod is in, when it is not at the top.

tags.description: Extra tags, added to the ones in the mod's manifest.
